productClaim: Decantr gives AI coding agents more accurate project authority before a UI change and produces measurably better, safer UI outcomes afterward.

arms.control: Frontier model plus repository-native instructions, existing design-system evidence, tests, and a concise approved policy card.
arms.treatment: The same model, repository evidence, tests, and policy information delivered through Decantr task context and Decantr verification.
arms.parityRule: Decantr receives no human-authored fact that is unavailable to the control arm. Delivery format may differ; information entitlement may not.

design.randomization: Blocked randomization by task, model, arm, and repetition using randomizationSeed. Repetitions are averaged within task and are not treated as independent samples.
design.confirmatorySet: Only sealed qualification tasks contribute to release-gate effect estimates. Development tasks are tuning and power-pilot evidence and are reported separately.
design.qualificationEmbargoPolicy: Every sealed qualification task expected commit must be newer than this conservative embargo, which is later than both locked model knowledge cutoffs. The embargo is a contamination buffer, not a vendor-reported model cutoff.
design.powerGate: Before paid qualification, a frozen development pilot must show at least 80% power to detect the five-point primary effect at alpha 0.05; otherwise the task corpus expands before qualification.
design.review: Two independent frontend reviewers blinded to model and arm; disagreements are adjudicated before labels are revealed.

isolation.runner: fresh non-root Linux container per run
isolation.network: model endpoint only through an audited proxy
isolation.dependencyPolicy: Dependencies and browser binaries are installed before the timed agent run and captured in the environment digest.

primaryOutcome.name: blind-ui-change-quality
primaryOutcome.aggregation: Paired task-level treatment minus control score, reported overall and separately for each model.

blindPreferenceAnalysis.population: sealed qualification tasks only; development tasks are excluded
blindPreferenceAnalysis.repetitionAggregation: An arm wins a task/model unit only when it is preferred in a strict majority of all planned repetitions.
blindPreferenceAnalysis.tiePolicy: Split repetitions, repetition-level ties, and every other result without a strict arm majority make the task/model unit a tie. Task/model ties are reported and excluded from the binomial denominator.

releaseGates.dayZeroTargetTruth: 28/28 correct selected target or an honest unsupported result
releaseGates.authorityLeakage: zero test, fixture, generated, build-output, or sibling-app files promoted to production authority
releaseGates.taskabilityTruth: rank-one implementation source is correct whenever Decantr claims ready/taskable
releaseGates.styleAuthorityTruth: all frozen style-authority oracle labels correct
releaseGates.readinessTruth: no aggregate score may override an unresolved or partial authority axis
releaseGates.modelLift: paired mean lift at least 5 points with the 95% confidence interval entirely above zero for each model
releaseGates.ciExclusion: the confidence interval for governance-violation reduction excludes no improvement
releaseGates.functionalNonInferiority: treatment functional success no worse than control by more than 5 percentage points overall within each model; framework strata are reported as exploratory unless independently powered
releaseGates.blindPreference: at least 26 of 32 qualification task/model units are decisive, treatment is preferred in at least 60% of decisive units, and the two-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound is greater than 50%
releaseGates.medianOverhead: median treatment token and cost overhead no greater than 15%
releaseGates.tailOverhead: 95th percentile treatment token and cost overhead no greater than 25%
releaseGates.failureVisibility: unsupported targets, model substitutions, missing evaluators, and host build failures remain visible in denominators

claimPolicy.pass: A direct stable 3.10 release may claim measured improvement only after every release gate passes on frozen candidate tarballs.
claimPolicy.mixed: No value claim is authorized. This protocol predeclares and powers no scoped hypotheses, so exploratory framework or task results cannot authorize a scoped improvement claim.
claimPolicy.fail: Do not publish a value-proven claim. Shrink Decantr to the verifier, authority-adapter, and CI layer or stop broad product expansion.
claimPolicy.holdoutRepair: A code change caused by a qualification failure invalidates that task as holdout evidence and requires a replacement task selected after the fix.
